summary: (scenarios atip.daterefusals.01, atip.daterefusals.03) [standards] Two assertions are weaker than their Then steps. atip.daterefusals.01 reads the offered spelling in the twelve places only for 23:59:60Z (next midnight); the 10:00:60Z -> 10:01:00Z case, the one that departs from the brief's wording, is asserted nowhere (the unit test covers .5Z and +01:00). atip.daterefusals.03 asserts the message contains `RFC 3339` and not `does not exist`, not that it is the 0.37 sentence; I compared 720 calls (30 misspellings x 12 places x --json and human) against 0.37.0 and every byte matched, so the behaviour holds, the test would not notice a reworded sentence. Blast radius: spelling refusals in --input documents (field /expiry) were not compared by the test.
